hero.subtitle: I transform technological complexity into clear, actionable solutions. No jargon, no complications, just results that drive your business forward.

about.title: About me
about.description: I'm Ivan, and I believe in technology that actually works. Over the years, I've seen how companies get lost in empty promises and solutions that don't deliver. That's why I decided to focus on what really matters: clear results, honest communication, and technology that drives your business without unnecessary complications. My goal is to help you make informed technology decisions, without unnecessary technical jargon, with a practical approach and measurable results.

aboutPage.pageSubtitle: IT professional with over 20 years of hands-on experience in systems, hardware, networks, and advanced technical support
content: I am an IT professional with over 20 years of hands-on experience in systems, hardware, networks, and advanced technical support. From my early days disassembling and optimizing computers, configuring networks, and diagnosing complex failures, my interest has always been in understanding how technology works from the physical level to system logic and how to make it work reliably, securely, and efficiently.

Over the years, my profile evolved naturally: to the solid foundation of physical and logical infrastructure, I added system administration (Windows, Linux, macOS), networks, basic technical cybersecurity, cloud deployments, and support in professional environments. This has allowed me to face real challenges, solve complex problems, and design solutions that not only work but endure over time.

My approach is not to build improvised solutions or impose technological trends. I work with clear technical criteria: operational stability, resource optimization, security awareness, and real cost-benefit for the business.

Additionally, I offer practical consulting on AI tools and their application in business productivity. I don't seek to sell magical solutions, but to integrate AI when it adds tangible value to workflows, documentation, support, or operational efficiency.

I have directly supported companies and professionals in resolving advanced incidents, improving existing infrastructures, and building coherent, secure technological environments aligned with their objectives.

I deeply value clarity, professional ethics, and honest communication. I work with clients and teams seeking lasting results, understanding of their systems, and a relationship of trust based on technical transparency.
There's no smoke or empty promises here: there's experience, proven judgment, and commitment to solutions that work.
aboutPage.closing: I don't implement technology for trends, but for technical judgment.

servicesPage.pageSubtitle: Comprehensive technology solutions tailored to your needs
servicesPage.pageDescription: Discover how I can help transform your technology infrastructure, optimize your processes, and drive your business forward with clear, actionable solutions.

items.title: Technology Consulting
items.description: Clear strategies to make informed technology decisions without getting lost in complexity.
items.longDescription: I provide strategic technology consulting that cuts through the noise. Instead of overwhelming you with technical jargon, I analyze your current situation, understand your business goals, and deliver clear, actionable recommendations. Whether you're choosing between technology options, planning infrastructure upgrades, or navigating digital transformation, I help you make decisions that align with your business objectives and budget.

items.title: Software Architecture
items.description: Design of scalable and maintainable systems that grow with your business.
items.longDescription: I design software architectures that are built to last. My approach focuses on creating systems that are not only scalable and maintainable but also cost-effective and aligned with your business needs. From microservices to monolithic architectures, I choose the right pattern for your situation. I ensure your systems can grow with your business while remaining stable, secure, and easy to maintain.

items.title: Digital Transformation
items.description: Step-by-step guidance to modernize your processes without disrupting your operation.
items.longDescription: Digital transformation doesn't have to be disruptive. I guide you through a step-by-step modernization process that minimizes risk and maximizes results. We start by understanding your current processes, identifying pain points, and then implementing solutions incrementally. This approach ensures your operations continue smoothly while you gradually adopt new technologies and processes that drive efficiency and growth.

items.title: Team Training
items.description: Practical training that actually improves your team's productivity.
items.longDescription: I deliver training that makes a real difference. Instead of generic courses, I provide hands-on, practical training tailored to your team's specific needs and your technology stack. My training focuses on real-world scenarios your team will actually encounter, ensuring they can immediately apply what they learn. From new technology adoption to best practices, I help your team become more productive and confident.

items.title: Process Optimization
items.description: I identify and eliminate bottlenecks that slow your growth.
items.longDescription: I analyze your workflows and identify bottlenecks that are slowing you down. Through careful examination of your processes, I find inefficiencies, redundancies, and areas where automation can make a real impact. I don't just identify problems—I provide concrete solutions that streamline your operations, reduce costs, and free up your team to focus on what matters most. The result is a more efficient, productive organization.

items.title: Executive Mentoring
items.description: Personalized support for leaders who need technological clarity.
items.longDescription: As a leader, you need to make technology decisions without getting lost in technical details. I provide executive mentoring that gives you the clarity and confidence to make informed decisions. I translate complex technical concepts into business terms, help you understand the implications of technology choices, and guide you through strategic technology planning. You'll gain the knowledge you need to lead with confidence.

items.question: What exactly does it mean that you are a "Technology Architect"?
items.answer: It means I design, integrate, and optimize complete systems: infrastructure, networks, servers, hardware, AI automation, security, and web platforms. I don't work on isolated pieces; I build the complete technological ecosystem that supports a modern digital business.

items.question: How does hiring a Technology Architect benefit me instead of several specialists?
items.answer: You don't need a programmer, a sysadmin, an automation specialist, and a security technician separately. I cover all these areas in an integrated way, ensuring coherence, stability, and efficiency. You save costs, reduce friction, and get a functional system from start to finish.

items.question: Can you analyze my current infrastructure and propose real improvements?
items.answer: Yes. I perform technical audits where I evaluate performance, security, configurations, compatibility, automations, hardware, networks, and deployments. I identify bottlenecks and deliver a clear strategic plan based on professional technical criteria.

items.question: What type of AI automations can you implement in my business?
items.answer: From intelligent operational assistants to advanced flows with n8n for administrative tasks, documentation, customer service, information classification, API integrations, and internal processes. Designed to reduce operational time and increase real efficiency.

items.question: Can you design the complete technological infrastructure of my company?
items.answer: Yes. From hardware and server selection to network configuration, virtualization, production environments, security, and web deployment. This includes scalability, basic redundancy, and best practices to avoid failures and downtime.

items.question: Do you also offer DevOps or SysOps services?
items.answer: Yes, with a practical approach adapted to small and medium-sized businesses. I configure environments, pipelines, secure deployments, VPS, basic containers, monitoring, and technical automations, without the unnecessary complexity of enterprise environments.

items.question: Can I change my entire technological environment even if you don't know how it's currently built?
items.answer: Yes. I have experience auditing and rebuilding legacy, hybrid, obsolete, or poorly integrated systems. I can migrate, modernize, and stabilize them without interrupting your operation.

items.question: Do you offer advice on equipment purchases or technological renewal of a company?
items.answer: Yes. I evaluate real needs, desired performance, compatibility, durability, and scalability. My approach avoids impulsive purchases or bad investments, ensuring that the chosen hardware performs and has a prolonged useful life.

items.question: What level of security can you implement in my systems?
items.answer: I apply practical technical security: server hardening, secure configuration, basic network segmentation, web best practices, attack vector review, operational shields, and monitoring. Realistic and effective security for SMEs and professionals.

items.question: What type of projects can you complete fully and turnkey?
items.answer:
– Modern corporate web
– VPS + deployment + security
– AI automation
– Hybrid systems (local + cloud)
– Networks and cameras
– Infrastructure for digital businesses
– Audits and environment modernization
– Comprehensive support and maintenance
